# Local static HTML file generated by a Node script

No versioned artifact. Node.js floor 16, checked against
https://nodejs.org/docs/latest-v16.x/api/child_process.html.

## Findings

- Opening: dispatch on `process.platform` to `open` (macOS), `xdg-open`
  (Linux), `start` (Windows `cmd.exe` built-in). On Windows `exec` uses
  `process.env.ComSpec`. `start` treats the first quoted argument as a
  title: use `start "" "<path>"` (ss64.com; not tested from Git Bash).
- npm `open` 11.0.4 needs `"node": ">=20"` and is ESM only
  (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sindresorhus/open/main/package.json).
- Data must be inlined: MDN says Firefox and Chrome "treat all local files
  as having opaque origins", so loading sibling files gives CORS errors.
  Global `fetch` is not on by default in Node 16.
- `localStorage` on `file:` pages: "the requirements for file: URLs remain
  undefined. So it's possible that browsers may change their file: URL
  handling for localStorage at any time"
  (https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Window/localStorage).
- MDN Secure Contexts lists a `file:///` page as "Secure (file URL)"
  (https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Security/Defenses/Secure_Contexts);
  whether the Clipboard API, `<a download>` and `showSaveFilePicker` work
  on a top-level `file://` page is not documented or tested.
  `showSaveFilePicker` is "Limited availability ... not Baseline" (MDN).
- Sharing means sending the file; no account, no third-party retention,
  no lock-in.

## Gaps

No browser test of edit-export methods on `file://`; Git Bash `start` not
tested.
